en: Black-and-white postcard showing people gathered and dancing or socializing under large pine trees along a shoreline. The sea is visible in the background. Greek and French captions are printed beneath the image, identifying the scene as Xylocastron in Greece, under the pines near the sea. A reference number is printed at the lower left, and a website watermark (www.elia.org.gr) appears across the image.
